mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it made reuse of a material across cell replacement clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The skin-growth combination was straightforward and the only available action at that point, so it involved less of a decision.

surprise.text: The recovered iron travels in blood carried by proteins, rather than as metal fragments.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; both pairings followed the pictures and goals, though the compatible options were supplied.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: seeing the iron reused was interesting, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
